paragraphs: I'm writing to apply for the Mid C#/.NET Developer role supporting your WebForms and MAUI applications. My background covers the same Microsoft stack this role calls for — ASP.NET, C#, T-SQL, jQuery, and cross-platform mobile development.

At Moreton Bay Technology, I maintained and troubleshot a supply chain management system across front-end and back-end layers, optimized SQL Server and Oracle databases with stored procedures and queries, built fixes using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript alongside C#, and managed source control with TFS, Azure DevOps, and Git. Earlier, at R Caldo Technical Consultancy Services, I built a Traffic Violation Management System with an Android electronic ticketing module using C# MVC .NET Framework, Xamarin, and SQL Server — hands-on experience with the exact mobile framework .NET MAUI evolved from.
I haven't shipped a production WebForms or .NET MAUI application specifically, but my ASP.NET and Xamarin background maps directly onto both, and I pick up framework-specific conventions quickly.
I'd welcome the opportunity to bring that experience to your team. Thank you for considering my application.
